display.purpose: Page-level h1 titles. Used once per page.

headline.purpose: Section headers, modal titles, card group labels.

title.purpose: Sub-section labels, card headers, complex table column groups.

body.purpose: All data-level text. The dominant size in the application.

label.purpose: Field labels, column headers, badge text, nav labels, metadata.

mono.purpose: Barcodes, SKUs, batch codes — identifiers scanned rather than read.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Cards on hover, interactive tiles. Signals elevation change on interaction.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Dialog overlays only. Maximum elevation level.

shadows.name: minimal
shadows.purpose: Small interactive chips, inline elements needing subtle lift.

shadows.name: sidebar
shadows.purpose: Rightward lateral shadow on the sidebar to distinguish from page canvas.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (hover, focus, color changes). 150ms.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Subtle spring for interactive feedback (button press, card lift). 200ms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single call-to-action per screen region. Command Blue fill, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; background: oklch(0.55 0.2 250); color: #fff; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.48 0.2 250); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: oklch(0.40 0.19 250); transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.2 250); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supplemental action adjacent to a primary. Blue-tinted fill with a border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; background: oklch(0.97 0.02 250); color: oklch(0.40 0.19 250); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid oklch(0.87 0.09 250); border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.93 0.05 250); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: oklch(0.87 0.09 250); transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.2 250); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-priority actions, row-level controls. Transparent background, subtle text.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.42 0.01 250); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.94 0.005 250); color: oklch(0.15 0.015 250); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: oklch(0.92 0.03 250); transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.2 250); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions only — delete, cancel order, void sale.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; background: oklch(0.55 0.22 30); color: #fff; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: oklch(0.48 0.22 30); } .ds-btn-danger:active { background: oklch(0.40 0.20 30); transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.22 30); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field. Clean stroke, clear focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.15 0.015 250); line-height: 1.25; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.01 250); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: oklch(0.15 0.015 250); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.6 0.01 250); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.55 0.2 250); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.55 0.2 250 / 0.15); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Primary content container. White on blue-tinted canvas.
components.html:
Stock Overview

124 active products across 8 categories
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.01 250); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.08), 0 4px 16px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.06); padding: 24px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(0.15 0.015 250); margin: 0 0 8px 0; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; color: oklch(0.42 0.01 250); margin: 0; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Operational status indicator. Always color + icon + label together.
components.html: ConfirmedLow StockOverdue
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge--success { background: oklch(0.93 0.05 145); color: oklch(0.40 0.17 145); } .ds-badge--warning { background: oklch(0.93 0.06 80); color: oklch(0.57 0.18 80); } .ds-badge--danger { background: oklch(0.93 0.05 30); color: oklch(0.48 0.22 30); } .ds-badge--info { background: oklch(0.93 0.05 250); color: oklch(0.40 0.19 250); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Primary navigation element. Compact, comfortable on tablet, clear active state.
components.html: DashboardProducts
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.45 0.015 250); text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(0.96 0.006 250); color: oklch(0.38 0.2 250); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: oklch(0.92 0.03 250); color: oklch(0.38 0.2 250); }

narrative.overview:
Dyventory is a command surface, not a consumer app. The people using it are operators — they need to understand the state of their entire business at a glance and act decisively. Every screen should feel like it was designed by someone who respects their time: information is dense where density is warranted, breathing where the task calls for focus, and never decorative for its own sake.

The palette is deliberately restrained. Command Blue anchors all actions and interactions; it earns its appearance by being rare. The majority of the screen surface is neutral — a cool blue-tinted canvas that reads as a professional workspace, not a marketing page. Status colors (red, green, amber) appear only when they carry a signal; they are never used for decoration.

This system explicitly rejects: generic admin panels that look like Bootstrap or Material UI out-of-the-box; SaaS showpiece dashboards that collapse under real data; mobile-first designs that sacrifice data density on desktop.
keyCharacteristics: Command Blue as the single action color — decisive, rare, trusted
Structural elevation: every surface level is distinct and readable
Dual-density design: data-rich for owners scanning reports, action-first for staff executing tasks
Status is never ambiguous — color + icon + label, always in concert
Touch-tolerant without sacrificing desktop data density

rules.name: The One Channel Rule
rules.body: Command Blue never coexists with signal colors at the same visual weight on a single surface. If a page has a danger action (red button), any primary actions nearby use the outline or ghost variant.

rules.name: The Size Floor Rule
rules.body: No text in the application goes below 12px (0.75rem). Ink Muted at 12px is already near the contrast floor on white; do not go smaller.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: All interactive elements start flat (or at ambient shadow). Elevation increases as a response to state — hover lifts, focus rings appear, active presses return to flat. Shadows are never applied as permanent decoration on static content.

dos: Use Command Blue only for interactive elements and active states. Its scarcity is its authority.
Pair every signal color with an icon and a text label. Color-only status is inaccessible and ambiguous.
Use structural elevation: keep canvas, card, floating, and modal levels distinct at all times.
Use 14px body text for all data-level content. Go up for headers, never down for copy.
Size all interactive touch targets to minimum 40×40px — the app is used on tablets.
Include :focus-visible rings on every interactive element — 2px solid Command Blue, 2px offset.
Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) alternatives to every animation.
donts: Don't use border-left wider than 1px as a colored accent stripe. Use full borders, background tints, or icon leading.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Single solid color only.
Don't build a hero-metric template (big number, small label, gradient accent) without supporting context.
Don't build identical card grids with the same icon + heading + text repeated.
Don't put uppercase tracked eyebrows above every section.
Don't build generic admin UI that looks like Bootstrap or Material out-of-the-box.
Don't build showpiece dashboards that collapse under real data.
Don't sacrifice desktop data density for mobile-first aesthetics.
Don't use the warm-neutral background band (cream, sand, parchment). The canvas is blue-tinted, not warm-tinted.
